name: Verified emails — inline verification launch

chatHistory.content:
Build a ~50-second launch video announcing Apify's inline email-verification feature for its Google lead-generation Actors (Google Maps Scraper, Google Search Results Scraper, Contact Details Scraper).

FORMAT
- 4K 3840×2160, 25fps, ~50s (about 1250 frames).
- Burned-in captions synced to the VO (bottom third, safe margins).

STYLE
- Apify's dark marketing surface. Apify ORANGE (#F86606) is the ONLY accent — buttons, highlights, the final payoff.
- Use semantic colours ONLY on the email-status pills: green = valid, red = invalid, amber = catch-all. These are a data-state traffic light, not branding.
- Smooth spring transitions and one subtle continuous camera move. No hard cuts. Never fade from or to black.

STATUS LABELS: exactly valid / invalid / catch-all. (Not "disposable".)

SCENES (keep all five, including the skill):

1) HOOK (~0:00–0:08). A cold-outreach sender fills with red "Delivery failed" rows; a Bounced counter ticks up toward ~1,250 (a quarter of 5,000); it lands on a red "Domain reputation: At risk" chip.

2) REVEAL (~0:08–0:16). The red clears; the headline "Verify emails in the same run" lands with an orange underline; three Actor chips slide in — Google Maps Scraper, Google Search Results Scraper, Contact Details Scraper.

3) THE TOGGLE (~0:16–0:30). A Google Maps Scraper input panel: the "Business leads enrichment" toggle turns on, THEN "Email verification" (tag it as pay-per-check — billed only when a check resolves). Then a dataset/output table where each row gets a status pill: valid / invalid / catch-all.

4) THE SKILL (~0:30–0:42). Skip the Console: a chat-style prompt to the "Verified Email Finder" skill types "dental practices in Austin — 5 contacts each, verified emails → Google Sheets"; an arrow animates to a clean Google Sheet whose Status column is all green "valid" — the ready-to-send list.

5) CTA (~0:42–0:50). The SAME sender window from scene 1, now all green "Delivered" with a "Domain reputation: Healthy" chip (the payoff mirror of the hook). End card: Apify logo + "Try it free" button + a link placeholder.

The hero transition of the whole piece is scene 1 (red / bounced / at risk) → scene 5 (green / delivered / healthy) — make them visually rhyme. Use clean in-code placeholder mockups for the Console panel, the output table and the Google Sheet.

Looking at this brief, I'll build a 5-scene launch video with the hero red→green rhyme. Let me write the complete Remotion file.



This delivers all five scenes with the hero red→green rhyme (identical `SenderWindow` component in scenes 1 & 5, just flipped state), semantic status pills reserved only for email states, orange as the sole brand accent, burned-in captions synced roughly to the VO beats, a continuous `cameraDrift`, `crossDissolve` handoffs (never black), and ambient micro-motion on every held element.

scriptWithTimestamps:
Launch short — inline email verification (toggle + skill) · ~50s

[HOOK]
You scraped 5,000 leads on Friday. By Monday a quarter of the emails bounce — and your sending domain is already getting flagged.

[BRIDGE / REVEAL]
Apify's Google lead-gen Actors now verify every email inline — in the same run that scrapes it. No second tool, no export-and-reimport.

[THE TOGGLE]
In Google Maps Scraper, switch on Business leads enrichment, then flip Email verification. That's the whole setup. Every address comes back tagged — valid, invalid, or catch-all — right there in your dataset. The same toggle lives in Google Search Results Scraper and Contact Details Scraper too, and you're only billed when a check actually resolves.

[THE SKILL]
Don't want to touch the Console? Grab the Verified Email Finder skill. Just tell it what you want — "dental practices in Austin," five contacts each, straight to Google Sheets. It picks the right scraper, runs verification for you, and hands back a clean, ready-to-send list.

[CTA]
Verified emails, from the same run that scrapes them. Create an Apify account and flip the switch — link below.
